messages:
maya: Heads-up: planning to roll out an autoscale policy tweak to dedicated GPU pools to reduce aggressive scale-down oscillation. Target window: Mon 2025-06-02 18:00 UTC (11:00 PDT). No model binary changes expected. Canary to two pools first.

sam: SGTM. Which pools and who owns smoke checks / monitoring?

maya: Pools: gpu-dedicated-nv4 and gpu-dedicated-rtx3. Kevin will monitor infra metrics, Olivia will run smoke tests, Tiago owns rollback readiness.

kevin: I'll watch p95/p99 latency, GPU util, and pod evictions. Ping me 15m before start so I can warm dashboards.

olivia: Smoke plan: soak for 15m, then run generator smoke script:
```
./tools/smoke_gen.sh --qps 20 --duration 900
```
Check failure-rate < 0.5% and avg latency < 250ms.

tiago: Rollback plan: revert `autoscale_policy_version` to v12 in the console or `terraform apply -var='policy=v12'`. If needed, restart `pool-controller` pod: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/pool-controller`.

maya: Canary fraction: 10% traffic replacement per pool over ~10 minutes. If any threshold breach -> immediate stop + rollback. Also enabling fallback route: requests exceeding 1.5s will auto-fallback to hosted small-models so customer-facing errors should be minimized.

sam: Quick question — does this change invalidate KV cache or cause cold starts?

maya: No KV invalidation. We're only changing scale-down thresholds and idle timeout values. No model reloads.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by maya for 2025-06-02T18:00:00Z. Canary targets: gpu-dedicated-nv4, gpu-dedicated-rtx3. Status: queued.

kevin: Pre-deploy dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/pools/gpu-dedicated-nv4 — ping me if you don't have access.

olivia: After canary: I'll run token-level sanity checks with `smoke_prompts/v2.json` and check outputs for regressions.

maya: TL;DR checklist for deploy time:
1) maya triggers at T0
2) deploy-bot starts canary
3) olivia runs smoke scripts
4) kevin monitors infra and latency metrics
5) tiago stands ready to rollback
If anything exceeds thresholds, we roll back immediately.

sam: I'll be on standby 11:15-12:00 PDT to help with metrics and notes.

tiago: Ack. I'll prepare the terraform snippet and tail infra logs: `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/pool-controller -f`.

kevin: If we see increased OOMs, evictions, or sudden token errors in logs -> rollback. Also watch `worker_restarts` metric.

olivia: Noted. I'll ping #eng-oncall 10m pre for extra eyeballs.

maya: Thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll post another reminder 30m before and start the canary at the scheduled window.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2025-06-02T18:00:10Z. Canary nodes: 2. Status: in-progress.

deploy-bot: Canary succeeded at 2025-06-02T18:12:45Z. No regressions observed in canary metrics. Proceeding to gradual rollout if no objections.

sam: No objections. Proceed when ready.

kevin: Going to keep monitoring for 30m, will call if anything weird pops up.

maya: Rolling to remaining pools now. Will post final status when complete.
